mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 58 degrees and foggy at Fireman Park under a Third Quarter moon. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but it will not be visible due to the cloud cover. Overnight, the temperature will hold at 58 degrees with rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced that Liz Gay is the new EMS Deputy Chief. She brings an extensive background in emergency medicine and administration. Also, as a reminder, residential refuse and recycling are collected by Pellitteri Waste Systems, so please ensure your carts are curbside by 7 AM.
There is yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza deals at Lake Lou-ee.
In our weekly report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I incident.
You can enjoy today's delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor at Culver's, which is currently open until 10 PM.
